data.name: Kaheel
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Khil’ meaning ‘protector’, ‘helper’ or ‘supporter’. The name Kaheel signifies an individual who is intelligent, wise and uses their knowledge and abilities to support and protect those around them.
data.spiritual_meaning: A spiritual name that signifies one who is intelligent, wise and uses their abilities to protect and support others on their spiritual journey.
data.numerology_meaning: A master number, Kaheel represents intuition, inspiration, and spiritual growth. They have the ability to turn ideas into reality and have a strong connection to their inner wisdom.

in_arabic.name: كحيل
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني شديد السواد أو العين
in_arabic.long_meaning: كحيل هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني شديد السواد أو العين, و هو مشتق من الكحول و الكحل الذي يستخدم للعين, و يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و عميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: کحیل
in_urdu.meaning: نام مطلب شدید سیاہی یا آنکھ
in_urdu.long_meaning: کحیل ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی اصل سے ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے شدید سیاہی یا آنکھ, یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے اور اسلامی ثقافت میں گہری اہمیت رکھتا ہے, خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے.

in_hindi.name: कहील
in_hindi.meaning: नाम अर्थ तीव्र कालेपन या आंख
in_hindi.long_meaning: कहील एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी मूल से है और इसका अर्थ है तीव्र कालेपन या आंख, यह नाम अरबी जड़ों से व्युत्पन्न है और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका विशेष महत्व है, जो इस्लामी परंपरा में गहरी जड़ों वाला है.

in_pashto.name: کحیل
in_pashto.meaning: د نوم مطلب ډیر تور یا سترګې
in_pashto.long_meaning: کحیل یو مذکر نوم دی چی عربي اصل څخه دی او د ډیر تور یا سترګې مطلب لري, دا نوم د عربي ريښو څخه اخیستل شوی دی او په افغان او پښتون دود کې یې ژوره اهميت لري.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kaheel is renowned in Islamic history for a significant figure in Arabian legends and tales. In one of such tales, Al-Kheil, or Al-Kamil, known as 'the perfect one', is considered the greatest of the jinn. He was created from smokeless fire, given an immortal soul, and is described as possessing the most unmatchable knowledge and wisdom among his kind. The name Kaheel holds heights of respect in various Islamic communities and is recognized with a special sense of awe and reverence for its rich cultural background and legendary significance.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Kaheel lies in the belief that Allah (God) is our ultimate protector and helper, and when we add the name Kaheel to our child, we are reminding ourselves that we are not alone in this world, and we have a responsibility to also protect and support our fellow human beings. The Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, has stated, "The strong is not the one who overpowers people but the strong is the one who controls himself in the face of anger." The name Kaheel is a reminder of the importance of self-control and empathy towards others, offering a profound spiritual emphasis on kindness, compassion, and unwavering support towards those around us.
